title: Teaching the immune system a different response.
disclaimer: This is a proposed therapeutic mechanism under preclinical investigation. It is not an established treatment effect in people.

steps.title: Targeted peptides
steps.body: ATH101 incorporates selected fragments of apolipoprotein B (ApoB), a protein associated with particles that transport cholesterol in the blood.

steps.title: Nanoparticle delivery
steps.body: A biodegradable PLGA polymer carrier packages the selected peptides for investigational delivery.

steps.title: Intended immune tolerance
steps.body: The formulation is designed to encourage an antigen-specific regulatory immune response that could reduce inflammation associated with atherosclerosis.

explore.a: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) are immune cells that help keep immune responses in balance and limit unwanted inflammation. The ATH101 concept aims to encourage Tregs that respond to specific ApoB-derived targets.
Apolipoprotein B (ApoB) is the main protein component of LDL and related lipoprotein particles. Fragments of ApoB can be recognized by immune cells in the artery wall.

The concept builds on academic research into immune responses in atherosclerosis, including work from the Ley laboratory. See the sources listed under Development. [Detailed background: PLACEHOLDER pending approval]

landscape.title: Where this research fits
landscape.intro: AtheroVax is a complementary research direction. It is not presented as clinically superior to established therapies.

items.d: Established therapies that target circulating cholesterol levels.
Investigational programs that explore genetically modifying cholesterol-related pathways.
An investigational direction that studies the immune response associated with arterial disease.
